shared_setup.time_anchor: Record actual UTC time N at case start. Historical fixture timestamps are offsets from N; current system time remains the real application clock. Preserve the recorded anchors in A/B and do not assume an existing clock-override setting.

shared_setup.unrelated_history_method: Seed these four completed synthetic pairs in this order through Store, one minute apart, identically in A/B. They are fixture history, not real model observations.
shared_setup.compaction_method: Reuse tests/continuity.rs saturation helpers in a disposable instance with tools/stickers off. Choose a context window starting at 12000 tokens, increased as necessary to fit the unchanged effective persona, actual fixed system text, reply reserve and 3000 tokens of source room. summary_tokens=500. Seed completed filler pairs of user '乙' repeated 4000 and assistant '答' repeated 4000 without LLM calls until retained history exceeds the measured input budget. Issue the test question and assert compactions increased; do not insert a fabricated summary.
shared_setup.restart_method: After completion and successful extraction, stop the disposable instance and reopen the same database/config; verify the effective persona and compaction cursor before the next turn.
shared_setup.extraction_method: Record the completed source message IDs, wait for their extraction receipts or explicit bounded failure, inspect active memory facts and source quotes, then ask the recall question. Report extraction failures separately from response style.
